record.title: Jul 11, 2026·China·ShengquChina gets a launch date: CMS Classic opens August 3Shengqu announced that the Chinese Classic server launches for real on August 3, 2026. This is a full launch, not a test, and Shengqu says it is built to run long term. At launch you get five classes (Warrior, Mage, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate), a level cap of 100 with the second job change, classic areas like Victoria Island and the Nautilus, and Free Market personal and hired-merchant shops. Pre-registration is open on the official site.Event
